summary: An experimental FM synthesizer firmware built from up to 64 paired oscillator cells that can be wired in parallel, serial, branching or feedback arrangements.
features: Selectable FM laws, up to eight-note paraphony
Multimode filter, VCA, wavefolder, bit-depth and rate controls, stereo reverb
One 64-position note sequence plus four CV lanes for parameter automation
USB and TRS MIDI note input on all channels; follows external MIDI clock
No MIDI output or CC mapping; 16 patch slots
Windows updater needs Python 3.12; other firmware may erase saved patches
